row.evidence: Helpjuice's pricing says plans differ by users, storage, SSO support and AI tools, and its SSO guide says that when no matching account is found a new user is created on SSO sign-in; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or API v3 reference.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Flat monthly plans (billing period not stated on the page): Knowledge Base $249/mo (30 users), AI-Knowledge Base $449/mo (100 users, adds SSO), Unlimited AI-Knowledge Base $799/mo (unlimited users); per-user fields stay null. No SCIM: provisioning is SAML/JWT/LDAP just-in-time creation on sign-in (optional Auto-Create Users), CSV import, and a REST API v3 with users, groups, deactivate/activate and user webhooks. The Okta OIN app (last updated 2017) lists SAML and SWA only; Entra uses a non-gallery custom SAML app. Group sync over SAML is a beta enabled by support. 'none' is by absence (rule 5): the help-centre sitemap (223 articles) and API v3 reference contain no SCIM.

plans.name: Knowledge Base
plans.notes: SSO is not listed on this card; it first appears on AI-Knowledge Base.

scim.notes: 'false' by absence (rule 5): no SCIM article in the help-centre sitemap or in the API v3 reference; user provisioning is just-in-time on SSO/LDAP sign-in.

auth.notes: One account-wide private key (Settings > API Credentials, Super Administrators and Account Owners only) sent in the Authorization header or as api_key; it grants Super Administrator privileges. HTTP Basic with a user's email impersonates that user.

endpoints.purpose: Create a new user (first_name, last_name, email, role_id, group_ids)
Retrieve all users (filter by email, name, groups, role)

audit_log_api.notes: An Activities resource (GET /api/v3/activities) exists but the docs do not describe it as an audit log.

limitations.text: Pagination default 25, maximum 1000 results per page.

user_api.notes: The pricing page does not say which plans include API access, so plan and api_tax stay null.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Jun. 2 2017) marks SAML and SWA as the only checked capabilities (read from the page markup); no provisioning.

entra.notes: No gallery app: Helpjuice's guide uses a non-gallery custom SAML application; the helpjuice-tutorial page on Learn returns 404.

google.notes: The help-centre sitemap lists a google-sign-in article (not loaded); no Google Workspace SAML or provisioning app found.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP / Active Directory sign-in also creates users on first login; Smart Groups auto-assign users to groups by email domain; SAML group-attribute sync (beta).
fallbacks.notes: JIT also works with JWT SSO and LDAP. SAML groups sync is in testing and must be enabled by support.
